cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Return to the First Hope
cards.instruction: Return to an early hope after every setback, expanding its meaning until the whole scene seems to fulfill it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll make this cottage ours. We wanted a place we knew every inch of.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll know every tile. I'll get the quotes; you can choose who does it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Even the cheapest might take all our savings.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll read the figures together before we sign. If we spend the savings, I want us sitting under a roof we chose.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 directs making cottage theirs; A3 shares contractor choice and A5 joint budget review turns repair cost into a chosen part of belonging.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 roof replacement causes A3 knowing tiles; B4 savings risk causes A5 slower joint signing decision.

relationship.evidence: B4 gives a real financial constraint and A5 neither denies it nor assumes agreement.

heightening.evidence: A5 expands ownership from knowing the building to choosing what their savings buy in response to B4 cost.

specificity.evidence: A1 cottage, A3 quotes and A5 savings/signing make the contemplated action explicit.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 now names savings and ends on the wanted shared roof, with no unexplained alternative household.
